label: Bible Study
prompt: In every thing give _____: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
verse: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
note: In every thing, not FOR every thing — a small preposition doing heavy lifting.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed are the _____: for they shall be called the children of God.
verse: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
note: Peace-MAKERS, not peace-keepers — the blessing is on the ones who build it.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the _____ brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
verse: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
note: Elijah's meal delivery at the brook Cherith came by raven — twice a day, no tips accepted.

label: Deep Water
prompt: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in _____ and in truth.
verse: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
note: John's test of love: vocabulary is cheap; the proof ships in deeds and truth.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in _____, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verse: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
note: In the KJV, 'conversation' means conduct — your whole walk, not your small talk.
